```{r}
library(iml)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# Original ILR predictors, before recipe preprocessing
X_ilr <- train_ilr %>%
  dplyr::select(-Yield_avg) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Predict through the complete fitted workflow
pred_fun_ilr <- function(model, newdata) {
  predict(model, new_data = newdata)$.pred
}

# Create the predictor used in your ILR ALE code
rf_predictor <- iml::Predictor$new(
  model = rf_fit_train,
  data = X_ilr,
  y = train_ilr$Yield_avg,
  predict.function = pred_fun_ilr
)
```

```{r}
# All eight ILR balances
ilr_features <- paste0("ILR", 1:8)

# Extract ALE results
ale_data <- purrr::map_dfr(
  ilr_features,
  function(variable) {

    effect <- iml::FeatureEffect$new(
      predictor = rf_predictor,
      feature = variable,
      method = "ale",
      grid.size = 20
    )

    effect$results %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        ILR = variable,
        value = .data[[variable]],
        ALE = .value
      )
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ILR = factor(ILR, levels = ilr_features)
  )

# Plot ALE curves
ggplot(ale_data, aes(x = value, y = ALE)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey60"
  ) +
 # geom_smooth(se = F)+
  geom_line(
    colour = "midnightblue",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "midnightblue",
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ ILR, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
    guide = guide_axis(check.overlap = TRUE)
  ) +
  labs(
    #title = "Random Forest: ILR spectral balances",
    x = "ILR value",
    y = expression("ALE effect on predicted yield" ~ (bu ~ ac^{-1}))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1, "lines")
  )
ggsave("Figures/Figures_01/ILR_ELA_plot_line.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
# Original VI predictors, before recipe preprocessing
X_vi <- train_vi %>%
  dplyr::select(-Yield_avg) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Predict through the complete fitted workflow
pred_fun_vi <- function(model, newdata) {
  predict(model, new_data = newdata)$.pred
}

rf_predictor_vi <- iml::Predictor$new(
  model = VI_rf_fit_train,
  data = X_vi,
  y = train_vi$Yield_avg,
  predict.function = pred_fun_vi
)

# VIs to interpret
vi_features <- c(
  "NDVI", "GNDVI", "SAVI", "NDRE", "NDMI",
  "EVI", "BSI", "CIrededge", "MSI"
)

# Calculate and extract ALE results
ale_data_vi <- purrr::map_dfr(
  vi_features,
  function(variable) {

    effect <- iml::FeatureEffect$new(
      predictor = rf_predictor_vi,
      feature = variable,
      method = "ale",
      grid.size = 20
    )

    effect$results %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        VI = variable,
        value = .data[[variable]],
        ALE = .value
      )
  }
)

# Preserve the specified facet order
ale_data_vi <- ale_data_vi %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    VI = factor(VI, levels = vi_features)
  )

# Plot ALE curves
ggplot(ale_data_vi, aes(x = value, y = ALE)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey60"
  ) +
 # geom_smooth(se = F)+
  geom_line(
    colour = "midnightblue",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "midnightblue",
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ VI, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    #title = "Random Forest: Vegetation indices",
    x = "Vegetation index value",
    y = expression("ALE effect on predicted yield" ~ (bu ~ ac^{-1}))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3),
    labels = scales::label_number(
      accuracy = 0.01,
      trim = TRUE
    ),
    guide = guide_axis(check.overlap = TRUE)
  ) 
ggsave("Figures/Figures_01/VI_ELA_plot_line.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```
